description.value: You are a highly skilled crafter, and you can make larger batches than normal in the same time. When you Craft consumables or ammunition, you increase the quantity that you can craft at one time by one half; for example, you can make six of a given consumable at a time instead of four. You must still pay the costs for the raw materials of the additional items.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
